title: Community service platform · SWOT scan
subtitle: Keep four lenses separate; each item is a hypothesis that needs evidence and an owner

cells.label: S  Strengths
items: Small pilots can move in stages

cells.label: W  Weaknesses
items: Goals and definitions are not aligned yet
Content quality needs a review path
Coordination time is limited at peaks

cells.label: O  Opportunities
items: Community partners can extend local reach
Open resources can widen service options
Lightweight feedback can guide the next round

cells.label: T  Threats
items: Accessibility needs can be missed without review
External platforms may change integration rules

footer: Original strategy canvas · statements are hypotheses, not organisational facts
assumptions: This is a cross-industry illustrative input, not an organisational assessment
Each item needs a source, owner and review date before a decision
